svg.title: Proof of Progress: a data-tile illustration
svg.desc: 111 selected claims: 51 Difficult, 36 Superhuman and 24 Superhuman — requires verification. Monthly counts from Jan 25 to Sept 26, including zero months. Fixed overview using the dashboard default evidence filters: unreviewed coding, no independent verification recorded. Each rounded tile is one claim, in monthly clusters from left to right; no axes or visible labels are drawn. Each claim counts once; incomplete claims use their highest possible category, not a predicted outcome. Pale purple means missing challenge-evidence coding, not proof verification. Latest month may be partial. Other categories remain available in the dashboard.
